name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
target_group: Eligible BPL senior citizens aged 60 years and above under NSAP rules
eligibility: Beneficiary must meet the current NSAP eligibility conditions; central assistance differs by age group.
benefits: Central pension assistance: ₹200/month for eligible BPL beneficiaries aged 60–79 and ₹500/month for age 80+, with states/UTs adding their own contribution as applicable.
application_process: Apply through the state/UT social-welfare or rural-development mechanism designated for NSAP.
source: Ministry of Rural Development / Government of India
